title: Text becoming rightbound for some reason when using certain characters?

posts.author: Madre_Joshua
posts.body:
I'm currently making a game in which characters occasionally text each other. As such, I wanted to make it so that occasionally, one of the characters uses kaomoji. I have had this idea since I was working with RPG Maker MV, where text displayed just fine and as intended, but now I've run into a strange issue.
Almost all kaomoji i use cause the text to irreversible be written from the right side in this incredibly strange fashion? It also moves the character's portraits over to the right for seemingly no reason? I've tried various ways to try and get it to look normal while kaomoji are used, but for some reason, it just won't work. What can I do about this?
